name: Ramón Castro Ruz
contribution: A Cuban revolutionary, activist and farmer.

checks.lead: Ramón Eusebio Castro Ruz (14 October 1924 – 23 February 2016) was a Cuban revolutionary, activist and farmer. He was the eldest brother of Fidel and Raúl Castro and a key figure of the early days of the Cuban Revolution. He kept a much lower profile than his brothers throughout his life, focusing on agriculture.
